drivingQuestion: What does the mishna's repeated closing clause add to the identical clause with which it opened?
outcomeNote: The unit is only the question; its answer, הא קמשמע לן, stands as the next unit.

segments.he: אֵין בַּעֲרָכִין פָּחוֹת מִסֶּלַע וְלֹא יָתֵר כּוּ׳. הָא תּוּ לְמָה לִי?
segments.en: § The mishna teaches at its conclusion that «there is no» payment «of valuations less than a sela; nor» is there a payment «greater» than fifty sela. The Gemara asks: «Why do I also» need «this» statement, as this halakha was already stated at the beginning of the mishna?
